maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Top row keypoints are distributed in a near-linear horizontal array, positioned approximately 1.5 times the average inter-point diameter superior to the primary dense row, with a slight posterior convergence.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 98% melanin saturation; the rhinarium surface exhibits a uniform distribution of low-luminance pixels across the visible apex.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: A concave contour is visible between the superior orbital ridge and the nasal bridge, forming a transition angle of approximately 145 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clusters of small, high-contrast dark pixel artifacts (localized insects) are concentrated on the rostrum and periocular regions.
